subject: [RFC PATCH 16/57] mm/collapse: freeze the sources behind migration entries

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch freezes the sources behind migration entries in the Linux kernel's memory management system, ensuring that faults and GUP-slow operations wait on a folio lock taken before the first entry becomes visible. The freeze is achieved by incrementing the expected reference count of the folio, preventing new references from being acquired while the copy operation runs. This patch also includes mechanisms for restoring displaced values in case of a failed copy attempt, and ensures that writeback operations are handled correctly.
